what: Approach claims chmod a-w on fixture `HOME/.codex/config.toml` plus plain `cp` forces login auth-prep failure because the destination stays read-only
scenario_or_breakage: `external_strip_codex_larch_env_provider` only fails its `-w` precheck when the temp target is non-writable (`scripts/lib-external-launcher-common.sh:539`); both call sites use writable `mktemp` dirs and plain `cp`, which normally creates a writable destination. Repo precedents that actually force failure use a `mktemp` shim that chmods the created home config (`scripts/test-launch-codex-ci.sh:126-138`) or a PATH `mv` shim (`skills/implement/scripts/test-codex-implementer.sh:445-449`), not source-only chmod
suggested_fix: For the new review-and-fix login auth-prep case (and any t7a hardening), copy one of those proven shims instead of relying on `cp` to preserve `a-w`; drop the inaccurate `cp preserves read-only` sentence from Approach
